usedFor: Each Jotform submission fills a new row in Google Sheets.

bestTemplate.name: “New Submission” in Jotform, then “Add New Row to Sheet” in Google Sheets
bestTemplate.why: Jotform pushes each submission as it arrives, and “Add New Row to Sheet” writes it.

watchOut: If you rename Jotform fields or reorder sheet columns, recheck the header or column-letter mapping.
